title: LOGOS ASF — Dataset Manifest
description: Schema for immutable versioned dataset artifacts produced by TR-03. training_allowed is always false at construction. Operator must separately authorize training via a signed training-job contract.

dataset_id.description: Content-addressed dataset identifier. Format: DS-YYYYMMDD-<sha256[:8]>. Derived from sorted accepted candidate IDs.

dataset_version.description: Dataset version string. Monotonically increasing for the same source configuration.

dataset_status.description: Status after all quality gates. training_allowed remains false even for dataset_validation_passed.

build_mode.description: simulation: accepts TEST_ operator IDs for dry runs. production: rejects simulated operators.

source_candidate_ids.description: Sorted list of accepted candidate_ids included in this dataset.

source_decision_ids.description: TR-02 decision IDs authorizing each accepted candidate.

source_hashes.description: Per-candidate content hashes for provenance tracing. Keyed by candidate_id.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full accepted dataset JSONL content in train+validation+test order.

training_allowed.description: Always false at construction. Operator must separately sign a training-job contract.

operator_promotion_required.description: Always true. A signed training-job contract is required before any training job may be submitted.

x-invariants.training_allowed_const_false: training_allowed is const:false. This manifest does not authorize training.
x-invariants.operator_promotion_required_const_true: operator_promotion_required is const:true. TR-04 training-job contract sign-off required.
x-invariants.evaluation_excluded: TAX2, BD1A, G4 variance cases, and other protected evaluation assets must not appear in train, validation, or test splits.
x-invariants.immutable_content_hash: content_hash is the authoritative integrity check for the dataset artifact.
x-invariants.simulated_approval_production_blocked: In production mode, decisions from TEST_ or _SIM_ operator IDs are rejected.
x-invariants.only_approved_training_candidates: Only training_candidate records with action=approve and resulting_status=dataset_promotion_pending are eligible.
